title: Death Soul Ritual / Connoisseur / Breath of Sixx
content:
Death Soul Ritual - Connoisseur - Breath of Sixx :

  • Death Ritual. In a dream, Sixx finished teaching Sig how to perform Death Ritual to "save" soul of any creature, friend or foe, that has died within 1 minute. 10 min ritual that requires spending a Spell Slot. Sig can gain benefits of a Short Rest while doing this, can roll HD to heal. And this ritual can also be combined with other rituals/spells dealing with the corpse, like Speak with Dead or any Necromancy.

  • Sixx told Sig - Graz'zt is happy with Sig doing some rituals for him. He says, “I'm starting to see you're a… connoisseur… of the finer things in life, just as I am. Pleasures come in all sorts. Next time you perform a ritual on a freshly slain creature for me… give it a taste. With a bit of luck, I think you won't be disappointed. “

  • Wisdom Save. Right after doing the usual ritual for Graz on a freshly slain creature, Sig can taste any part of the creature, but roll a Wisdom save (secret DC).

  • Fail?  Gain a Madness level!

  • Pass?  Sig gets new ability to enjoy the pleasures... of the world's many wonderful flavors. Now a Connoisseur of unusual foods. 

  • Must store the essence  In order to keep the ability for later use, Sig must capture the essence inside something, preferably something smashable like a vial or bottle or EGG. Each is a single-use ability similar to the unicorn coal charms

  • When Smashed  Action/Bonus/whatever makes most sense.

  • Duration  Lasts 1hour usually.


Connoisseur Abilities Earned:

  • Tentacle Attack from Shuushar

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. This attack originates from the point the vial was smashed, not from you. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 6 bludgeoning damage plus 2d8 necrotic damage. On hit, target is Grappled. A creature can use its Action to make a DC 16 Strength check to free itself or another creature from this grapple. OR you can do opposed grapple checks instead if you prefer.

  • Bite Attack from the Spider King

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. This attack originates from the point the vial was smashed, not from you. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d8 + 3 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but Poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is Paralyzed while Poisoned in this way.

  • Mind Mastery from a Duergar Cultist of Demogorgon

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. You target one creature you can see within 60 feet of the broken vial. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw, or you force it to use its Reaction, if available, either to make one weapon attack against another creature you can see or to move up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. Creatures that can't be Charmed are immune to this effect.

  • Skill Prof from Nothic

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. You gain Proficiency in Stealth for 1 hour.

  • Spell from a Derro Cultist

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. You cast the Spiritual Weapon spell, originating from the point the vial was smashed, not from you. Use your normal spell attack mod.

  • Spiritual Weapon

  • Level 2 Evocation

  • Range: 60 feet

  • Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

  • You create a floating, spectral force that resembles a weapon of your choice and lasts for the duration. The force appears within range in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of the force. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

  • As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the force up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

  • Immunity from The Alchemist

  • Use an Action to smash the vial. You gain Poison immunity for 1 hour
